segments.he: מהרנ"ת אחז פעם בזקנו ואמר זקן לבן ועוד חסיד ברסלבי "אווייסע בארד אין נאך אברסלבר חסיד" (היינו שהנסיון להיות חסיד ברסלבי הוא כ"כ תמיד בלי הרף רגע שכבר יש לו זקן לא ועדיין הוא חסיד ברסלב).
segments.en: Once on Shabbos they took away his shoes and his outer garments — the kaplitsh and kaptan — so he could not go to Moharan'as for the third Shabbos meal. He was in great anguish and did not know what to do. His heart burned: how could he not be with Moharan'as? They had a thick coarse gentile garment. He put it on and went — without a hat, without shoes, wearing only the coarse gentile garment — to Moharan'as [it was summer]. He walked through the streets in this manner until he reached Moharan'as. And it goes without saying what humiliation and shame this was, since he was the most distinguished of the young men of his town.
